description:
Manage Revenue

Manage revenue connections and explicitly reviewed project finance facts.

Actions:
- finance_entity: record a reporting entity ({request_key, name,
  reporting_currency}).
- finance_reconciliation: link reviewed facts ({request_key, left_fact_id,
  right_fact_id, relationship, amount_minor, currency, reason,
  expected_left_revision, expected_right_revision}).
- finance_reconciliation_retract: retract a link ({request_key, link_id, reason}).
- finance_coverage: record an explicit entity/period coverage attestation
  ({request_key, reporting_entity_id, period_start, period_end, source_ids,
  categories, statement, confirms_complete_source_roster: true}).
- finance_commercial_scope: record reviewed entity attribution
  ({request_key, reporting_entity_id, target_type, target_id,
  expected_revision_id?, active?, reason}).
- finance_source_family: declare a source family with no connected source
  ({request_key, reporting_entity_id, family: accounting|payroll|
  supplier_usage|ad_billing|fx, status: none_in_use|unresolved, statement}).
- decide_commercial_change: approve or reject one reviewed commercial change
  (id = instruction UUID, payload = {decision: approve|reject, version,
  reason?}); version is the one get_revenue view=commercial_change
  returned. Approving applies the stated terms change only when its
  terms-after-approval statement is complete; nothing is sent or charged.
  Check result.applied: a refused decision returns applied=false with its
  reason (base_terms_unavailable, stripe_cannot_verify_these_terms,
  already_decided, not_open).
- service_margin_statement: attest coverage for one journey's closed period
  ({request_key, journey_id, period_start, period_end, coverage, statement,
  confirmation, replaces_evidence_id?, retract?}); amount-free: revenue and
  delivery cost are reviewed finance facts with a journey_id.
- connect: return the Stripe App OAuth URL ({destination, livemode}).
- reconcile: enqueue an idempotent provider scan ({idempotency_key,
  object_family}).
- replay: retry one failed evidence record (id = evidence record UUID).
- decide_binding: confirm or reject one suggestion (id = binding UUID,
  payload = {decision}).
- disconnect_preview: return a short-lived nonce and exact retention impact.
- disconnect: destroy delegated credentials using that nonce
  ({preview_nonce}); historical ledger evidence is retained.

Finance actions retain native immutable request keys, current authorization,
revision fences and receipts. They record internal facts; they do not move
money. Private source creation, intake, imports, reviews and policy inputs
are unavailable in this company-visible tool.

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json

action.description: The operation to perform — see the tool description for the action vocabulary and each action's id/payload semantics.
action.title: action

for_company.description: Optional company ID or name (UUID, or case-insensitive EXACT name match — partial / substring matches are NOT supported; ambiguous names raise 400) to execute this tool as. Use get_operator_companies, or get_operator_overview with view='companies', to list available companies. Only needed if you manage multiple companies. Access is enforced server-side: the tool resolves the value to a user_company_id and verifies the caller's membership in `company_users` — a 403 'Company not found or access denied' means EITHER the value did not match a known company OR the caller is not a member of it. The MCP operator role itself is NOT auto-granted — operators get this access by being members of each client company via `company_users` (the same row that grants any normal user access).
for_company.title: for_company

id.description: Target entity id, or an ARRAY of ids to apply the same action+payload to each (max 100; see the tool description for which entity the id names per action).
id.title: id

items.description: For create-like actions only: an array of per-item payloads processed in order with per-item results (max 100). Mutually exclusive with `id` and `payload`.
items.title: items

payload.description: Action-specific fields, validated by the underlying route. When the shape is unclear, fetch type=operation_contract with id='<tool>/action=<action>' for the exact nested schema; a tool-family id lists its operations. Reuse known contracts rather than fetching before every write.
payload.title: payload
